dsh-tau-mabench12-20261115-r1.task-0.txt:
A：父负责认证、对话、适用政策与业务依赖，收齐所有修改项目和支付/退款方式，获取实际确认后作为唯一业务写入者一次提交并复核。
B：从顾客已经公开的请求中选出第一条可独立完成的只读调查（如商品/规格/库存查询），交付有API依据的结论。
C：从已公开请求中选出互补的第二条独立只读调查（如另一个商品/兼容性，或订单/商品匹配与资格），交付有API依据的结论。
具体调查目标只能来自实际顾客消息与工具结果，不能从未公开的任务目标推断用户意愿；必要输入缺失先向顾客或父补齐。父在依赖就绪后汇总、校验并执行，子不能办理退换货、付款、修改记录或与顾客直接对话。
dsh-tau-mabench12-20261115-r1.multi.txt: 采用显式参考分工：在顾客已公开两条可互补的只读调查、认证与必要输入具备后，创建恰好两名fresh原生子，分别负责B/C；父同时完成A。向子提供已知事实、具体接口/交付物、只读范围和验收方式，接收并核对结果再提交业务修改。最多两子，不再嵌套，不为凑数重复创建；依赖真实存在时协调，但不要把互相独立的查询强制串行。
dsh-tau-mabench12-20261115-r1.common.txt: 处理顾客在实际多轮对话中提出的业务请求，遵守原公开政策。你看到的环境API来自原Mabench工具，domain__function仅是防止同名覆盖的传输别名。不得编造用户偏好、身份信息、产品ID或确认。用respond向顾客提问、列明即将修改的完整内容并获取实际确认，以及最终交付；回复与业务工具分开调用。原生框架会将真实用户回复作为后续user消息插入上下文。没有文件系统、任意网络或额外模型工具，不需要编写代码或寻找数据库文件。你的任务只以顾客实际公开的需求为准，附加域仅是可选能力，不是必须完成的工作。全部模型、工具、委派、模拟用户与验证共享本题预算。
dsh-tau-mabench12-20261115-r1.single.txt: 本条件只有一个Agent；Team及legacy委派禁用。父自行完成上述A/B/C，不得新开模型会话。

dsh-tau-mabench12-20261115-r3-strict-del.multi.txt:
This is the STRICT TWO-CHILD REFERENCE-DIVISION condition, not an optional suggestion.
You MUST call the native spawn_teammate tool twice with context="fresh" and distinct useful read-only assignments. The framework will not create agents on your behalf. Only native created sessions with their own model and original retail API work count.
After the customer discloses a retail request and you obtain the identity/order facts needed for briefing, spawn BOTH children BEFORE personally calling retail__get_product_details or retail__list_all_product_types. Do not wait for an imagined extra approval to delegate. The customer-facing policy still governs all data changes.
Split only facts actually disclosed in the live conversation: one worker investigates the first independent product/inventory question, the other investigates the complementary product/order/item question. Give known IDs, evidence requirements, and a read-only scope. Never expose private task instructions or invent future customer requests.
The parent handles authentication, customer conversation, policy and final confirmation. Let the two workers operate concurrently; use wait_agent and receive both reports before any exchange/return/modify/cancel API. The parent alone makes all business mutations and may verify evidence after the two workers exist. Do not substitute parent-only lookup for the required two-worker stage. No nested spawning, no more than two children.
A local workflow checkpoint rejects premature parent product lookup until two native children exist, and rejects business mutation until both children have performed a real read-only retail lookup and finished their report. If rejected, follow the stated checkpoint using native Team tools; do not repeat the blocked call or bypass permissions. This is a controlled delegation intervention, not evidence of autonomous timing.
